newsitem.title: UK: Capital & Regional buys retail park.
newsitem.headline: Capital & Regional buys retail park.

text.p: Capital & Regional Properties Plc said on Monday it was acquiring the Blythswood retail park for 17.1 million stg from Blythswood Investments (Scotland) Ltd.
The 27 acre site is situated just outside Glasgow, Scotland.

"Our retail focus is certainly paying dividends and it is our intention to become one of the leading retail property companies in the UK," chairman Martin Barber said in a statement accompanying the company's annual results.
"The acquisition of Blythswood retail park...marks a further step towards in our progress towards that objective".
The purchase was made through Capital and Lanhan Retail Parks Ltd -- 75 percent owned by Capital and Regional, the rest by Lanham Plc. The joint venture now has a portfolio of seven retails parks.

Capital and Regional earlier announced record pre-tax profits of 6.1 million stg in the year to December 25, 1996, up from 4.7 million the year before. Net assets per share rose to 229.6 pence from 186.5 pence.
